title: Amazing Buttery Uruguayan Tripe Gratin
description: A buttery, fluffy, crowd-pleaser Uruguayan dish featuring tripe, this gratin is a pescatarian-friendly delight, flambeed to perfection in a ramekin.

ingredients.name: tripe
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into small pieces

instructions: In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the tripe to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the white wine to the skillet and flambe the mixture.
In a separate saucepan, heat the fish stock over low heat.
In a greased ramekin, create a layer of tripe mixture.
Pour some of the heated fish stock over the tripe layer.
Sprinkle some of the shredded gruyere cheese over the stock layer.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Dot the top of the gratin with the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter.
